investigation_findings.c_plus_plus_contract: C++ owns simulation, physics, HP, damage, movement; Lua owns pure behavioral evaluation via update_enemy(ctx) returning action table.

DEF-008.title: Coincident Elimination Timestamp Race

root_cause.test_fixture_defect: Test comment claims elimination at t=10s and t=20s, but mgr.Update(10.0f) was omitted between ProcessElimination(3) and ProcessElimination(2). Both eliminations occurred at t=0.1s.
root_cause.production_tie_breaking: ResultCalculator::CalculatePlacements groups participants whose timestamps differ by <0.001s as a joint tie, assigning both Rank 2.
root_cause.compiler_asymmetry: Release build defines NDEBUG, compiling out assert() so the discrepancy went unnoticed in Release.

proposed_modifications: tests/match/test_match_lifecycle.cpp (Advance match clock by 10s between eliminations)
src/results/ResultCalculator.cpp (Add secondary deterministic tie-breaking on kills, damage, and event sequence)
tests/match/test_match_lifecycle.cpp (Add dedicated simultaneous same-tick elimination tie-break test)

DEF-009.title: Debug Network Handshake Polling Timeout

root_cause.polling_loop_cutoff: Test polling loop hardcoded for (int i = 0; i < 50; ++i) sleep_for(10ms), totaling 500 ms maximum duration.
root_cause.declared_timeout_mismatch: client.Connect() specified timeoutMs = 2000 ms. The test loop gave up after 500 ms, discarding 75% of the timeout window.
root_cause.debug_execution_overhead: Under MSVC Debug (/Od /RTC1), context switching and stack checking push handshake latency to 550-850 ms, exceeding the 500 ms cutoff.
root_cause.distinction_from_sandbox_blocks: Test 37 runs on ephemeral port 19991 within a single process. Localhost handshake succeeds when allowed sufficient time, distinguishing it from multi-process socket sandbox restrictions (DEF-002 / DEF-006).

proposed_modifications: tests/network/test_network_transport.cpp (Modernize polling loops to steady_clock deadlines up to declared timeoutMs)

environmental_limitations.DEF-002_DEF-006: Four multi-process network tests (Tests 38, 39, 46, 48) remain blocked by Windows container sandbox UDP socket binding restrictions. Preserved as documented external environment restrictions.
